author: Xbox
description:
In this episode of the Official Xbox Podcast, things are heating up as we blend visual art and the art of combat in a very unique way. We're chatting with the folks from Double Fine about their soon to be released pottery party brawler, Kiln. They're telling us all about what they''ve learned from testing, how players changed the way they see the game, how they blend a social art experience with ceramic-based combat, and so much more.

00:00 Introduction
01:28 What is Kiln and what can players expect jumping in for the first time?
03:06 And your actual shape matters, right?
06:16 Quench mode and play testing
11:02 Smashing and sharing pots
12:26 Have there been any trends that popped up when players desigin their pots?
13:44 Have you noticed any emmerging gameplay metas from the gameplay testing?
15:55 Strategies when playing Quench mode
17:47 What's the thing you're most excited for players to experience when playing Kiln?
21:11 Final thoughts

Listen to us on Spotify/Apple Podcasts
title: Kiln: The Pottery Brawler About Creation and Destruction | Official Xbox Podcast

description:
Get Fired Up for the Throwdown

Kiln is a pottery power-fantasy that celebrates both Creativity and Destruction: the pleasure that comes from both making beautiful things, and then smashing those things to smithereens. 

Create your pot, grab your friends, and join a team of colorful spirits who face off against one another in online arenas, where the ceramic creations you sculpt on a pottery wheel become the bodies you bring into battle.

Coming April 23, 2026. Pre-order now!

https://www.xbox.com/games/kiln

Play Day One with Game Pass Ultimate and Game Pass PC
